name: What is the difference between a minor update and a full renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a minor update and a full renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor update typically involves cosmetic changes like painting, replacing a vanity, or updating fixtures without altering the layout or major plumbing/electrical. A full renovation, on the other hand, usually includes more extensive work such as demolishing existing structures, reconfiguring the layout, replacing major components like the shower/tub, and often involves new plumbing or electrical work. Full renovations are more comprehensive and transformative.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor update is cosmetic, while a full renovation involves extensive changes like demolition, layout alterations, and replacing major components.
